en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard composed of four photographs. The upper left image shows a two‑storey Baroque or Neoclassical manor‑like building with dormer windows, a central entrance with balcony, and a small bell turret on the roof, fronted by a circular flowerbed and a driveway. The upper right image depicts an interior dining room or banquet hall with patterned wallpaper, curtains, simple wooden chairs and rectangular tables set with vases and tablecloths. The lower left image shows a workshop or factory room with several people (likely women) seated at desks, working with small machines or assembly tools under task lamps. The lower right image presents another view of the same manor‑style complex from the courtyard side, featuring a tower-like entrance bay with a small spire and weathervane, surrounded by trees and neighboring buildings. There is no legible printed or handwritten text visible on the front side.
